Added typed explicit TrialReferencePoints and TrialReferenceBank independently of the regular-grid decoder objective. Existing grid APIs and default FullJets policy remain. Opt-in ReconstructSecondBands retains full coefficient/cross/release jets and value/first normal bands, reconstructs second bands into one demand-allocated buffer per curvature worker, and preserves full curvature, determinant and transpose results. Readout-only workers retain no derivative reconstruction buffer. Reconstruction counters propagate through worker sums and ML deltas. No value-only surrogate is claimed.

Frozen development candidates 4x2x1, 4x1x2, 8x1x1 achieved 237/256, 256/256, 239/256; the preregistered count/p95 criterion selected 4x1x2. Fresh, disjoint confirmation: N30 64/64; N300 255/256 (99.609%), p95 .000597729 < .001. Both conditional scenarios pass the unchanged >=95% primary target. N300 boundaries 22/27, N30 boundaries 24/27; all paired noise-0/noise-1 samples pass (32/32 N30, 64/64 N300). Every one of 566 exact-prepared comparisons passes the original-observation target. One candidate readout uses one routed reference, three inverses, one correction, zero actual-shape factors. All attempted outcomes are retained. This is sampled fixed-shape accuracy, not uniform certification or decoder qualification.

Next: integrate the selected reference policy and compact storage into the actual decoder/output path using one <=8-reference bank, without adding a second legacy grid bank or exceeding the legal candidate/terminal budget. Run fresh decoded N30/N300 recovery before a full timing sweep. Original-observation error certification within the extra-inverse allowance still needs a production solution; existing dense interval validator is diagnostic only. Qualify actual peak memory (including concurrent continuous-shape temporaries) and B0 throughput after that integration. Keep the domain scientifically provisional and boundary failures visible. Epic remains doing; PHRF-11 review, PHRF-14 open, PHRF-33 open/not admitted.
